title: Quadruple Alliance (1815)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Quadruple Alliance (1815)", at revision 1337367818, opens: "The Quadruple Alliance was formed by the monarchist Great Powers of Austria, Prussia, Russia, and Great Britain to counter the military and revolutionary republican political threats posed by the expansion of the First French Empire under Napoleon I and to fight the War of the Seventh Coalition." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1997647, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1815 alliance between Austria, Prussia, Russia, and the UK". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
